news.title: Blizzard Buffs Dungeon Enemy Experience Gains
news.description: Blizzard has just buffed the experience gains from dungeon creatures by a massive 50%
news.details:
After the dungeon changes buffed experience from dungeon quests and nerfed dungeon experience from mobs, many players adopted a one-and-done strategy for dungeons. Players felt like it was not worth their time to do it again, since the majority of the experience was from the quests themselves. With this hotfix, it won't feel as bad to run a dungeon again if your friends need help.
At about 11:05 PST today, we deployed a hotfix that increased kill experience in dungeons by 50%, so it feels better to go back in for more runs.
Happy dungeon crawling, and good luck with those Deviate Hides!

news.title: Everything About WoW: Forever Raids - Joardee Interview on WoW: Forever
news.description: Joardee interviewed Josh Greenfield and Tim Jones on WoW: Forever and discussed everything about WoW: Forever's raids!
news.details:
Check out Joardee on his YouTube Channel, Twitch, and Twitter.
We've summarized the key points from the interview below.
Raid Philosophy
Tim Jones is really excited about having different raids.
When we go back to Blackwing Lair and Molten Core, they want it to feel familiar but new.
Narratively, they plan to use those raids to mark various points in time.
For Season of Discovery, Scarlet Enclave was super fun and creative, but maybe too challenging.
They maybe pushed things too far at the end of SoD with the complexity of boss fights and tuning.
Will be really exciting when they can reincorporate Scarlet Enclave back into Forever down the road.
They want the encounters to be approachable. Somewhere in the realms of the difficulty and complexity of the Season of Mastery raids and baseline Naxx.

news.title: The Darkmoon Faire is Coming To Elwynn Forest First in WoW: Forever
news.description: The iconic Darkmoon Faire event will be making its first stop in WoW Forever in Elwynn Forest, giving the Alliance the first home-field advantage.
news.details:
The iconic Darkmoon Faire event will be making its first stop in WoW Forever in Elwynn Forest, giving the Alliance the first home-field advantage to the event.
Players in Elwynn can see the Faire being set up, and the in-game calendar lets all players know the fair will be active on Monday, with the event going on for one week.
The Darkmoon Faire has fun mini games, reputation farms, and rare items to obtain, but one of its most iconic purposes in Classic WoW was obtaining the powerful world buff: Sayge's Dark Fortune of Damage, giving players a 10% damage buff for 2 hours. We've learned that World Buffs in Forever will not work the same way they did in Classic, as they won't be allowed in raids, but will still work in the open world.
With this being the first Darkmoon Faire of Forever, we don't yet know if there are any new surprises in store. We'll have to wait and see once the Faire…

news.title: Layering Issues in Thousand Needles Harpy Cave Result in Quest Competition Issues
news.description: There's a harpy cave in the Thousand Needles where layering appears to be broken, leading to quest competition issues.
news.details:
In the Thousand Needles, a set of quests leads you into the Roguefeather Den, which is filled with harpies. These quests include:
Test of Endurance
Stop the Screeching
Stolen Freewind Supplies
The problem with the Roguefeather Den is that layering appears to be broken inside this cave, leading to a massive number of players in a tiny area. This creates heavy competition for spawns, especially when trying to tag certain mobs for quest objectives. Both Grenka Bloodscreech and Screeching Windcaller have rarer spawns and these quests may take a long time because of the layering issues.
Lots of people.
Inside this cave, you can see other players attacking things, but not what they're attacking. In addition, you seem to get hit by the AoE silence effect of the harpies in other layers, but can't see anything in yours. This seems to indicate that the layers are only partially combined and…

news.title: Quests Give No Gold at Level 60 in WoW: Forever - "Intentional Change" According to Jokerd
news.description: Quests at level 60 give no gold and according to Jokerd, this is an intentional change.
news.details:
Quests at level 60 give no gold and according to him, this is an intentional change.
Jokerd accomplished the World First level 60 in WoW: Forever yesterday and he has now discovered that quests can not give Gold. At max level, quests in Era and Retail give bonus Gold instead of experience, but in WoW: Forever that appears to not currently be the case. Jokerd claims to have messaged a WoW developer, who replied that this change is intentional, with a possible Weekly quest giving a random amount of gold instead.
While Blizzard hasn’t formally commented on this yet, it will be a while before other players reach max level to check for themselves. Recent changes like the adjustment to Auction House listing prices and the addition of BMAH vendors, who provide an unofficial market cap on some reagents, show Blizzard is clearly trying to moderate the economy. Until more players reach level 60…

news.title: GMs Appeared In-Person to Celebrate the Launch of WoW: Forever
news.description: For the first time in years, players have seen GM characters in-game - many appeared to celebrate the launch of WoW: Forever!
news.details:
With at least two confirmed sightings in Thunder Bluff last night, along with at least one Alliance location, it seems that Blizzard is just as excited about the launch of Forever as players have been.
The last time GMs were seen in numbers in the world was for the launch of Classic Anniversary. Since then, GM sightings have been extraordinarily rare, if not non-existent. Many players fondly remember Vanilla, when a GM might appear to help with a ticket you'd put in, crack jokes with players, or simply enjoy the game like everyone else. Over time, that happened less and less frequently, until GM appearances were all but unheard of.
One detail that many players noticed once sightings started pouring in: every GM had the last name Snowstorm, a cheeky homage to Blizzard. They also all had jokes!
We can't know for sure if this is a one-time event or if we'll be seeing GMs more often in…

news.title: World First Level 60s in WoW: Forever in Less Than Three Days
news.description: The World First level 60 has been claimed in WoW: Forever. Congratulations!
news.details:
The World First level 60 has been claimed in WoW: Forever - by a group of five all leveling at the exact same time. Congratulations!
After almost 52 hours, the World First level 60 has been claimed in WoW: Forever. Congratulations to the following characters for leveling so quickly!
Jokerd Prime
Burning Speed
Cloud Bells
Lmgd Mmr
Vitochie Gofast
This team of 5 worked together to pull massive amounts of mobs and then AoE'd them down for efficient experience gains. The Paladin would pull everything, and then the mages would use Arcane Explosion to AoE them down quickly.
Everyone went to painstaking lengths to make sure the experience was as synchronized as possible - as Jokerd explained on his stream, even one experience point could make the difference between one player being left behind. The last four percent of level 59 were the most challenging, with quite a bit of extensive math…
